text:
Alex: FYI — last 30m there's a 2.3x median token latency bump on /generate?mode=function routes. Suspect KV cache churn + kernel fallback.
Priya: Looks like it correlates with a push at 11:38 — any deploy notes? @Josh?
Josh: Rolled runtime v2.19 at 11:38 — adjusted kernel selection thresholds (preferred AVX kernels for <=512 tokens) and reduced prefix retention TTL as an experiment.
Marta: Pulling a trace now. Early look shows heavy time in `fn_validate` and `serialize_structured_out`.
PerfBot: perf-summary: tokens=1.9M; median_per_token=8.2ms (baseline 3.4ms) — spike started ~11:40.
Alex: Pasting a short trace excerpt:
```
11:41:02 REQUEST id=xyz
kernel_select: 0.8ms
kv_lookup: 1.2ms
kv_miss_fetch: 5.4ms
decode_token: 12.7ms
fn_validate: 9.6ms
serialize_structured_out: 7.1ms
```
Priya: kv_miss_fetch looks high. We lowered TTL last week for prefix retention — could be causing more cold fetches.
Josh: We do LRU+size-decay and reduced retention from 2h -> 30m for the devops cost experiment. I can revert quickly.
Marta: Also seeing retries in fn_validate: ~2-3 attempts on ~4% of function requests. That lines up with higher serialize times.
Alex: Can we get per-route KPIs? The global token dashboard is useful but need function-route splits.
PerfBot: Snapshot created: https://redwood.internal/dash/snap/1779123456
Per-route medians:
- /generate (regular): 3.1ms
- /generate?mode=function: 8.2ms
- /chat: 4.0ms
KV hit rate overall: 72% -> function routes: 58%
Priya: 58% KV hit on function routes is low — function routes often have longer prefixes because of tool contexts.
Josh: Hypothesis: the AVX kernel path increases per-token decode time for our small-batched short sequences; combined with lower TTL we get more kv misses and retries.
Marta: Proposal: A/B — revert kernel chooser to previous logic for function routes AND revert prefix TTL to 2h for an hour; measure.
Alex: +1. Also add instrumentation for `fn_validate_time` and `fn_validate_retries` (token-level and per-request).
Priya: I'll add metrics: `redwood.runtime.fn_validate.latency_p95` and `redwood.runtime.fn_validate.retries_count` and a dashboard tile for per-route slices.
PerfBot: Quick synthetic script (1000 requests) results:
```
scenario A (current): p50=8.4ms p95=18.9ms fn_validate_avg=9.3ms retries_pct=3.8%
scenario B (revert kernel+ttl): p50=3.2ms p95=8.1ms fn_validate_avg=2.1ms retries_pct=0.4%
```
Josh: Compelling. I'll rollback kernel chooser and TTL at 12:05 and run a canary on /generate?mode=function for 30m.
Marta: I'll enable 5% trace sampling for function routes and dump KV keys for failing traces.
Alex: Assigning: Josh (rollback + canary), Priya (metrics + dashboard), Marta (trace sampling + kv dump). I'll monitor and coordinate.
PerfBot: Alert rule created: if function-route kv_hit_rate < 60% OR fn_validate_retries > 1% -> page oncall.
Priya: Adding notes to the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fn-validate — will link the dashboard.
Josh: Rolling back now, will report back in 30m.
Alex: Thanks — please ping when the canary completes.
Josh: Canary finished: early numbers match scenario B. p95 down ~2.4x. Leaving rollback live for 1h before full rollout.
Marta: Saved KV snapshots for failed traces and attached to the incident folder for analysis tomorrow.
PerfBot: Trend chart shows return to baseline after rollback. Closing loop — archiving this thread. :white_check_mark:
